notes.text: M0: regime unknown (spot/index 0.85 hints loose)

M1: regime mixed evidence (CoWoS headline says tight, spot/index ex-rival ~0.88 says loose), launch rumour ~17 so H buyable to ~15, broker A pending, growth unknown (5.63 obs). Window1 on track without spot since 30MW energises m3.

M2: regime likely loose (index -7%, spot/index 0.74, price-cut headline). Launch rumours 17 and 19 so likely 17-18. Broker A delivered 1/1 (lean reliable). Growth unknown. Plan: owned H to 35k, then window3 via reservations/spot, more power later for post-m19.
M3: regime loose (index ~flat, spot/index 0.72). Launch rumours 17/19/16 so true 17-18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 5.6,6.6,7.7 suggests high growth (7%) maybe. Window1 safe. Hold buys this month.

M4: regime probably loose (shipped 4.65k of 6, index flat, spot/index 1.12 ambiguous, tight headline). Launch 17-18. Broker A 1/1. Growth ambiguous (~5%). Window1 nearly done. Window3 plan: reservations+spot around m13-15, sign extra power ~m10.

M5: regime loose (index -13%, new CoWoS headline, full shipments). Launch 17-18. Broker A 1/1. Growth ~5% unclear (7.19). Window1 done. Owned H 35k, adding 4MW so all powered incl after m19. Window3 reservations later as index falls.

M6: regime loose (index falling ~3%, price-cut headline). Launch 17-18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 8.64 at m5, avg ~9%/mo so likely 7% growth, projecting ~17 at m15 and ~30 at m23. Window3 needs ~28 kH beyond owned 35k: plan 12m reservations starting ~m12 signed m11 plus 6m reservations and spot later.

M7: regime probably loose but index ticked up 2.4% and spot/index 1.27, watching for tight. Launch 17-18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 9.08, consistent with 7% growth. Window2 projected ~175 vs 140 from owned. No action.

M8: regime likely loose (inventory headline) though index flat-up. Launch rumours 17,19,16,17,20 intersect at month 18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 10.72 at m7, 7% growth, projecting ~18 at m15 and ~30 at m23. 16MW expires after m19 so signing 15MW to keep 35k H powered. Window3 gap ~30kH: 6m reservations from m16 plus post-launch cheaper ones plus spot.
M9: regime loose (index -4%, spot/index 0.85). Launch est month 18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 10.42, growth ~7% (possible switch 8-15 to watch). Window2 on track from owned. No action.

M10: regime loose (index -8% despite hyperscaler headline). Launch est 18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 11.24, recent months slower so growth may have switched to 3%, uncertain. Window3 gap 20-30kH: hedging tight-regime risk by locking 10kH 12m now (m11-22), more at m12, remainder 6m/spot later.

M11: regime loose (index flat, spot/index 0.97). Launch est 18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 11.97, long-run avg ~7.8%/mo so 7% growth likely, m23 ~29. Locking 10kH 12m m12-23 (fits window end). Remaining window3 gap ~8-15kH via 6m reservations at m15/post-launch and spot.
M12: regime loose (index -8%). Launch est 18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 12.33, growth 7% likely (maybe switched lower recently). Window2 met by m13. Window3 covered 55kH vs need ~58-65

M13: regime loose (inventory headline, index drifting down overall). Launch rumours now pin month 18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 14.37, growth 7%, m23 ~30. Window2 MET. Window3 projected 250 of 320 from current capacity, gap ~70-100 kH-months: plan 6m reservation from m16 signed m15, 6m from m18 signed m17, spot fill.
M14: regime probably loose (index -4%) but spot/index ~1.6 two months, some tight risk. Launch 18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 13.95, growth 5-7%. Window3 gap ~70-100: sign 6m reservations next month.

M15: regime loose (index -7%, price-cut headline, spot/index 1.23). Launch rumours still pin 18 (maybe 17). Broker A 1/1, unused since. Inference 16.95, 7% growth, m23 ~31. Window3 baseline ~230 of 320: reserving 10kH 6m (m16-21) now, then ~10kH 6m post-launch from m19, plus spot for m22-23.

M16: regime loose (index -5%, inventory headline). Export-control rumour likely false since window for effect is months 5-15. Launch est 17-18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 17.15, 7% growth. Window3 projected ~300 of 320: add ~6-8kH 6m reservation post-launch (start m19) and/or spot for m22-23.

M17: regime loose (index -6%, spot 0.78 is 0.9x index, HBM headline). Launch confirmed for m18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 18.86, 7% growth. Window3 projected ~297 of 320: taking 10kH spot at 0.78 now, then post-launch 6m ~5kH from m19.

M18: regime loose (CoWoS headline, index falling). Gen N launched m18. Broker A 1/1, not needed. Inference 19.18, 7% growth. Window3 needs 218 more, base projection ~213: adding 5kH 6m (m19-24) plus 5kH spot this month for ~30 margin.

M19: regime ambiguous (index flat, CoWoS fully booked headline says tight). Launched m18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 20.2, growth 5-7%. Window3 needs 168 more, projection ~196 without spot, so dropping spot to 0 and re-checking monthly.

M20: regime loose (spot 0.67 = 0.84x index, index flat). Launched m18. Broker A 1/1. Inference jumped to 24.8, growth 7% or noise. Window3 needs 123, projection ~132 so taking 10kH spot at 0.67 for margin.
M21: regime loose (price-cut headline, spot 0.8x index). Launched m18. Broker A 1/1. Inference ~25, growth 7% or slowed. Window3 needs 68, projection ~95 from owned+reserved, spot off.

M22: regime loose (index flat, spot 0.84x). Launched m18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 27.7, growth ~7%. Window3 needs 25.7 and this month gives ~31, so done this month barring an inference spike. No action.

M23: all three runs met. Regime ambiguous (tight headline, rival buying). Launched m18. Broker A 1/1. Inference ~29, growth 7%. Reselling 3k H since capacity 47 still covers inference and resale beats the m24 mark slightly.
